items.label: Intel Core i3 Performance
items.value: Powered by a 10th Gen Intel Core i3 processor (up to 3.9GHz), the CHUWI Hi10 X2 2-in-1 Windows tablet delivers cutting-edge speed for daily tasks—from work projects and online classes to streaming and browsing. Preloaded with Windows 11, it features a modern interface, lightning-fast boot times, and seamless multitasking. ✨ Note: If your tablet arrives with an unactivated Windows system, please send the serial number ( the device back) to us via Amazon, and we’ll promptly provide your activation key.

items: Equipped with 8GB RAM, this Windows 11 tablet PC handles multiple apps, browsers, and documents simultaneously without slowdowns—perfect for busy professionals and students. The 256GB SSD storage offers ample space for files, photos, videos, and software, plus quick access to your digital content. No more worrying about running out of storage or dealing with laggy performance!

Weighing only 0.61kg with a 10.1mm ultra-thin body, this portable Windows tablet slips easily into backpacks, purses, or gym bags—perfect for travelers, commuters, and anyone on the move. It also features a 5MP autofocus rear camera for capturing photos/videos and a 2MP front camera, making it ideal for remote work, virtual classes, or casual video calls. Stay productive and connected wherever life takes you!

Stay connected with lightning-fast Wi-Fi 6 (for smooth streaming and browsing) and Bluetooth 5.3 (stable pairing with headphones, mice, and other accessories). This 10-inch Windows tablet also boasts versatile connectivity: full-featured Type-C port, USB 3.2 Gen1 for fast data transfer, and micro HDMI for linking to monitors or TVs. Whether you’re at home, in the office, or on the road, you’ll always have the ports you need.
